title: Maximum garage and carport parking spaces, R50 and above, Perth and Peel (Table 2.3a)

evaluator.label: maximum 1 (studio/1 bed) or 2 (2+ bed) garage and carport spaces per dwelling

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Footnote 1: no maximum garage and carport parking applies to R40 and below. Maximum applies to garages and carports only; extra spaces may be uncovered, undercroft or basement. Same values in Location A and B. Coding R50+ follows the footnote wording 'R50 and above'; whether the named code R100-SL is included is not stated.
text: Applies to development within the Perth and Peel regions only. C2.3.1 Car parking is provided on site in accordance with Table 2.3a. Table 2.3a Car parking provisions for development within the Perth and Peel regions, Maximum garage and carport parking for R50 and above (per dwelling)(1), Location A and Location B: Studio and 1 bedroom dwelling 1; 2 bedroom dwelling 2; 3+ bedroom dwelling 2. (1) No maximum garage and carport parking applies to R40 and below. Maximum carparking applies to garages and carports. Additional parking may be provided as uncovered spaces, undercroft or basement parking.

verified.note: Values match p18. 'R50 and above' does not name R100-SL; coding R50+ kept as encoded.
